versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 0 of 14 stations of this ecoregion pass. 0 reference curves use local stations, 22 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 2 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.  No station of this ecoregion passes the reference screen, so every reference curve here borrows its reference stations from a parent ecoregion.
